method_name: Multi-model comparison for neuron segment merge prediction
key_structural_ingredients: Binary classification with class imbalance handling
Multiple model families: linear, tree-ensemble, neural network
assumptions: Features 0-19 represent morphology, intensity, and embedding modalities
Class imbalance (~10% positive) addressed via class weighting
Standard train/test split provided (no cross-validation needed)
invariants: All models evaluated on identical test set
Same feature set used across all models
deviations: SHAP computed on LightGBM instead of XGBoost due to version incompatibility
Hyperparameters not exhaustively tuned (reasonable defaults used)
